Team —

Quick reminder for the EMEA/APAC commit gate happening today at 17:00 BST. This is the last formal sweep before finance locks the May close. Please take these actions before EOD APAC / 17:00 BST: 

- Update stage to either "Commit" or "At Risk" in the pipeline sheet for every >$50k opp.
- For commits, confirm expected close date and contract type (Hosted / Dedicated / Private).
- Upload final procurement artifacts (SLA, PO intent or signed SOW) to the linked sheet.
- Tag any deals needing an SLA exception with a one-line reason so finance can triage quickly.

I attached the regional commit lighthouse workbook with a highlighted tab per AE. Fill only your tabs. Finance will export the final list at 17:30. If you expect a last-minute signed DocuSign, note it in the "Pending Docs" column and paste the envelope link.

Attachments: regional_commit_lighthouse_may11.xlsx (xlsx)

Why this matters: finance will only include deals marked Commit with supporting docs in the close. Anything left as "Forecast" will be excluded from May revenue. We had several mis-flagged deals last month; want to avoid that.

If you hit blockers (procurement questions, SLA exceptions, or legal redlines), flag Neha and me immediately.

Thanks —
